_note: Hand-coded by research-to-publication's reproducer, 2026-10-02, from the committed Lessons sections of each repo's lead playbook at the pins in sources.json. One record per dated lesson. same_event_as links a lesson copied from another repo, or written about the same event, to the original; distinct events are the records with same_event_as = null. Lesson dates are as written (they follow UTC: studio's '09-30' lessons 8-14 were committed on the evening of 09-29 EDT; mir-triage's 09-28 lessons were written into the playbook on 10-01 when the kit was ported). Descriptions are scrubbed: the client, its people and products, the org's executives and any track are not named. Verified for coverage by check_incidents.py.

cause_classes.resource contention: one shared Mac: CPU, memory, the machine-wide test lock
cause_classes.concurrency/coordination: several leads on shared state: claims, the board, the shared checkout, merges
cause_classes.deploy/live safety: the live app and its auto-deployer
cause_classes.process/review: planning, briefs, gates and reviews that let a defect through or wasted effort
cause_classes.tooling defect: a bug in the org's own lead tooling
cause_classes.environment/OS: shell, PATH, reboots, package managers, the agent's tool environment
cause_classes.session lifecycle: sessions ending (lock screen, context limit) mid-work
cause_classes.privacy/data handling: private data where it must not be
cause_classes.communication: relayed messages, wording of requirements, where instructions live
cause_classes.content policy: what may be shown or copied (references, realism, product shape)
cause_classes.domain method: a lesson about the product's own method, not the org

lessons.description: A plan sequenced contract, backend, then web; the screens the user asked for came last.
lessons.harm: the asked-for UI was furthest from done
lessons.fix: visible slices split out first
lessons.rule: triage by what the user asked to see

lessons.description: Worktrees under /tmp vanished on a reboot with an uncommitted fix round.
lessons.fix: worktrees moved under .worktrees/
lessons.rule: keep worktrees in the repo and commit WIP

lessons.description: A contract change regenerated the API spec but not the web client, so trunk's drift check would fail.
lessons.fix: regeneration added to every contract brief
lessons.rule: contract briefs include client regeneration

lessons.description: A doc promised a nightly backup that was never built; the health check found it.
lessons.harm: a promised safeguard did not exist
lessons.fix: backup built; docs checked against code
lessons.rule: verify claims in docs against the code

lessons.description: A requirement that nothing is ever lost was too strong for the user and was rewritten as recoverable within reason.
lessons.fix: requirement reworded (bounded history)
lessons.rule: no open-ended audit trails

lessons.description: UI reviews of one requirement took 3 to 4 rounds.
lessons.fix: builder gets the reviewer's probe specs as tests
lessons.rule: reviewer measures what a failure loses

lessons.description: The pre-push secret guard refused its own test fixtures (fake keys).
lessons.fix: allowlist marker at the push tip
lessons.rule: prove a clean history scan with a dry-run push

lessons.description: A fresh lead found no claims, took every in-flight node and launched duplicate agents into the same worktrees.
lessons.harm: duplicate agents on the same nodes
lessons.fix: claims made before any dispatch
lessons.rule: claim before you dispatch; treat recently moved branches as owned

lessons.description: Sourcing the env script inside a worktree under zsh left an old system Node on PATH.
lessons.fix: env script resolves the main checkout via git
lessons.rule: check the env script first when a tool is missing

lessons.description: Two leads shared one main checkout for direct commits and integration.
lessons.harm: risk of swept or lost edits
lessons.fix: direct trunk commits under the integrate lock
lessons.rule: never leave uncommitted edits in the shared checkout

lessons.description: Sessions near their context limit need to stop taking work and hand off.
lessons.fix: handoff into the In-flight table
lessons.rule: stop at ~45% context, drain claims, write the handoff

lessons.description: The integrate script counted trunk's own commits as unreviewed after merging trunk into the branch.
lessons.fix: check excludes commits reachable from trunk
lessons.rule: lead writes the PASS marker after looking at screenshots

lessons.description: Agents were overkill for three small nodes (cold start plus rate-limit resume each).
lessons.fix: dispatch rule by node size
lessons.rule: small nodes inline, agents for big ones

lessons.description: Committing a board state on a branch made the integrate merge conflict on the board file.
lessons.fix: resolve with trunk's copy and re-run
lessons.rule: built on the branch; ready and merged only on trunk

lessons.description: A script was rewritten in place while a run of it was live; the deployer died with a syntax error.
lessons.harm: a deploy run died after its work
lessons.fix: write to a temp file and rename; parse whole via main()
lessons.rule: never rewrite a running script in place

lessons.description: A merge conflict in a generated file was committed with its markers; the lint gate caught it (2,258 errors).
lessons.fix: regenerate generated files after any merge
lessons.rule: generated files are regenerated, never resolved

lessons.description: Conflict markers reached trunk when a commit-all in the shared checkout swept up another lead's conflicted file.
lessons.fix: integrate refuses branches with markers (step 2b)
lessons.rule: name files; never commit-all in the shared checkout

lessons.description: A hung test suite held the machine-wide test lock at 0% CPU for an hour while other leads queued.
lessons.harm: about an hour of lock time lost
lessons.fix: merge trunk before the full suite; kill rules for hung runs
lessons.rule: after two hangs the lead takes the branch over

lessons.description: Every lead died overnight at a lock screen and left its claims and uncommitted files.
lessons.fix: liveness checked by process list; the user force-releases claims
lessons.rule: message the other fresh leads with a split at once

lessons.description: A lead's edits, including an unfinished migration, landed in the main checkout; the auto-deployer would have migrated the live database.
lessons.harm: near miss on the live database (paused in time)
lessons.fix: deployer reads committed head; holds dirty migrations
lessons.rule: name the worktree by absolute path in every command

lessons.description: A rebuild restarted the worker and killed a run in flight; the health check wrongly advised a rollback.
lessons.harm: one job attempt lost (retried in ~5 min)
lessons.fix: rebuild defers worker restart while a job runs (ADR 0042)
lessons.rule: read the re-queue before rolling back

lessons.description: One browser-test run at default workers drove load to 81 on 8 cores for 40 min; a regex filter matched the worktree name and ran the whole suite.
lessons.harm: deploy gate failed, a live job died, another lead waited 30 min
lessons.fix: 2 workers locally; spec paths, never bare words
lessons.rule: check load before any heavy run; only the owner stops its run

lessons.description: A board change sat uncommitted and another lead's integrate committed it; a deploy wait cap reset per target and waited 30 min.
lessons.harm: state committed by the wrong session; 30 min deploy wait
lessons.fix: set-and-commit as one locked command; cap counts the waiting
lessons.rule: a cap on waiting must count the waiting

lessons.description: A heredoc nested in a heredoc ended early and the shell ran test code in the lead's session.
lessons.fix: patch scripts written to a file and run
lessons.rule: never nest heredocs in shell commands

lessons.description: A new edit action shipped with an e2e that used one input; on the user's real data in a demo the action failed.
lessons.harm: a failed action in front of the user
lessons.fix: e2e performs the action by every input on realistic data
lessons.rule: prove an action by doing it the way the user will

lessons.description: Two serial test sessions in one virtualenv corrupted a JIT cache and later runs crashed.
lessons.fix: one suite per venv
lessons.rule: one test suite per virtualenv

lessons.description: A plain dependency sync removed an optional extra.
lessons.fix: repeat the flag
lessons.rule: never sync the checkout another department runs

lessons.description: A cleaned scratch dir left a published page as the only copy of its sources.
lessons.fix: sources kept in pages/
lessons.rule: sources never only in a scratch dir

lessons.description: Stem-set grouping: a file's folder is a strong prior, never proof.
lessons.fix: grouping failures become detectors plus tests
lessons.rule: flag unconfirmed members for a listen

lessons.description: Anonymous agent worktrees piled up (19 merged leftovers).
lessons.fix: worktrees named by node
lessons.rule: remove a node's worktree when it merges

lessons.description: The app that runs this engine restarts a half-done run when the engine checkout's head moves.
lessons.fix: board on its own branch; a separate release checkout
lessons.rule: nothing committed casually to the checkout others run

lessons.description: Trunk drifted from the formatter (6 files) because nothing checked it.
lessons.fix: integrate runs a format check
lessons.rule: format before handing a node over

lessons.description: Three departments ran on one Mac at once: load 29-44, about 7 busy cores from one department's agents.
lessons.fix: the load cap (6 busy threads per department, nothing heavy above load 15)
lessons.rule: brief every agent with the load cap

lessons.description: (inherited) default-parallel test run starved the live app.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: heavy runs under the shared lock, niced

lessons.description: (inherited) a cd did not persist; edits landed in a main checkout.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: name the worktree by absolute path

lessons.description: (inherited) default-parallel test run starved the live app.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: heavy work under the shared lock, niced

lessons.description: (inherited) a check that a control exists missed a failing action.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: perform the action on realistic data

lessons.description: A ragged cut-out edge on the first sample ad passed every review; the user and a stakeholder saw it.
lessons.fix: edges inspected at 2x on a loud colour
lessons.rule: gate cut-outs on an edge-quality metric

lessons.description: The shared Mac reached load 44 with three departments' agents, and no cap was written down.
lessons.fix: the cap written into the playbook
lessons.rule: name the cap in every brief; tell the owning lead

lessons.description: An unrequested concept that reshaped a real product's photo went onto a shared page with no review and a stakeholder saw it.
lessons.harm: a failed concept shown to a stakeholder
lessons.fix: evaluator PASS required before any stakeholder page
lessons.rule: concepts change colour only; no new products unless asked

lessons.description: (same event) a ragged cut-out edge passed every review.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: zoom on edges before anything reaches a person

lessons.description: A lead's name relayed through two sessions was misread twice.
lessons.fix: names settled in the session concerned
lessons.rule: names and roles in the user's words only

lessons.description: A test that only checks something exists misses that the action fails on real data.
lessons.fix: run the stage on realistic inputs
lessons.rule: look at the result, not the control

lessons.description: Copying a reference ad's tagline mechanic and naming its brand on a page crossed the user's line.
lessons.harm: internal page crossed the references rule
lessons.fix: scrubbed and rewritten
lessons.rule: references are taste, not material

lessons.description: A faint line on a product edge was judged too small at 2x; on a dark background it read as an outline and the user caught it.
lessons.fix: edges judged on the real background colour
lessons.rule: gate edges by a number, not by eye

lessons.description: The user set realism as the quality metric for edits.
lessons.fix: one light, one camera, real contact; scanned CC0 surfaces
lessons.rule: an edit that is not believable is not shown

lessons.description: (same event) a reshaped-product concept was shown and judged a fail.
lessons.fix: concept deleted
lessons.rule: never reshape a real product's geometry

lessons.description: After the reshaped-product fail, the user chose two pages: a private review page first, a showcase only for what the user promotes.
lessons.fix: two-page flow
lessons.rule: no lead publishes to the showcase on its own judgement

lessons.description: The older review artifact was retired; items go to the org's swipe app with stable ids, and an evaluator PASS is enough to show them.
lessons.fix: one swipe app for all departments
lessons.rule: items carry stable ids under the decisions contract

lessons.description: (inherited) default-parallel test run starved the live app.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: heavy work under the shared lock, niced

lessons.description: (inherited) a check that a control exists missed a failing action.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: test on realistic data, assert the output changed

lessons.description: (inherited) a ragged cut-out edge reached people.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: gate on an edge-quality metric

lessons.description: (inherited) an unreviewed reshaped-product concept reached a stakeholder page.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: evaluator PASS before stakeholder pages; never change a product's shape

lessons.description: The user superseded the rule above: the evaluator's PASS alone is the gate to stakeholders.
lessons.fix: gate simplified
lessons.rule: PASS alone gates stakeholder pages

lessons.description: (inherited) default-parallel test run starved the live app.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: heavy work under the shared lock, niced

lessons.description: (inherited) a check that a control exists missed a failing action.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: test on realistic data, assert the output changed

lessons.description: A handoff recorded the client's product name and measurements in another repository's git.
lessons.harm: private data committed (later purged from history)
lessons.fix: history purged; method only in git
lessons.rule: the numbers stay in the client's files

lessons.description: Leads refused full autonomy when it was relayed from another session, which was correct.
lessons.harm: a relayed grant was not honoured (by design)
lessons.fix: approvals taken from the user directly
lessons.rule: the gateway carries direction, never approval

lessons.description: An org-root instruction file is loaded by every department's session.
lessons.fix: only org-wide truths at the root
lessons.rule: department kits stay in their own repos

lessons.description: (same event) client measurements in a git handoff had to be purged.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: private details never in git, not even in method notes

lessons.description: (inherited) default-parallel test run starved the live app.
lessons.fix: see source
lessons.rule: heavy work under the shared lock, niced

coordination_events_from_history.description: During the 3-lead trial a node's 'ready' board state was overwritten by another commit to trunk and set again a few seconds later.
coordination_events_from_history.source: studio commit messages at the pin

coordination_events_from_history.description: Two leads created the same fix node; the one whose claim came second was dropped from the board.
coordination_events_from_history.source: studio commit message at the pin

coordination_events_from_history.description: The trial record lists three coordination conflicts (a claim on nodes another lead's agents had started; a node announced a minute after another lead's atomic claim; two leads committing board state from one checkout), each settled by the claim table or an agreed rule.
